title: The Holy Spirit
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Pentecost (Acts 2:1-4) and names works of the Holy Spirit: helper, comforter, guide, teacher, strength.

floor.prerequisite: Knows Jesus promised the Holy Spirit.
floor.question: Whom did Jesus promise to send to his disciples?

representations: a festival line: Christmas, Easter, Pentecost
steps: Say what they heard and saw.
Name works of the Holy Spirit.
Place Pentecost on the festival line.

board.do: Wait for the child to say no, it looked like fire.
Write the works of the Holy Spirit.

misconceptions.ask: What rested on the disciples at Pentecost?
misconceptions.repair: Read Acts 2:3: what seemed to be tongues of fire.

listen_for: A storm that blew the house down
misconceptions.ask: What did the disciples hear at Pentecost?
misconceptions.repair: Read Acts 2:2: a sound like wind, filling the house.

misconceptions.ask: What happened on the day of Pentecost?
misconceptions.repair: Make a three-card line: Christmas (birth), Easter (rose), Pentecost (Holy Spirit came).

misconceptions.ask: Name a work of the Holy Spirit in a Christian's life.
misconceptions.repair: List the roles from John 14:26 and Luke 24:49 in simple words: helper, teacher, comforter, strength.

checks.question: What did the disciples see at Pentecost?
checks.answer: What looked like tongues of fire

checks.question: Name a work of the Holy Spirit.

skills.key_step: The child names five fruit of the Holy Spirit (Galatians 5:22-23) and spots them in actions.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the Holy Spirit came at Pentecost.
floor.question: On which day did the Holy Spirit come on the disciples?

representations: a fruit tree chart with nine labels
steps: Say which fruit you will show this week.

board.do: Draw a tree with nine fruit, some labels missing.

board.say: Which fruit of the Spirit could go here?

board.do: Wait for the child to name one.
Write all nine on the tree.

misconceptions.ask: Is a mango a fruit of the Holy Spirit?
misconceptions.repair: Draw a tree with words on it: love, joy, peace. Say: these grow in our lives.

misconceptions.ask: Which is a fruit of the Spirit: patience or money?
misconceptions.repair: Read Galatians 5:22-23 and circle each fruit.

misconceptions.ask: Juma waits calmly for his turn on the swing. Which fruit is this?
misconceptions.repair: Act out each fruit and guess its name.

misconceptions.ask: How many fruit of the Spirit are named in Galatians 5:22-23?
misconceptions.repair: Count the nine fruit on the board.

checks.question: Name a fruit of the Holy Spirit.
Sharing your food shows which fruit?
